name: WBSC eBaseball: Power Pros
summary: Experience the virtual world of baseball available in WBSC eBASEBALL: POWER PROS. The most played baseball game series in Japan is now featured in the World Baseball Softball Confederation’s eSport discipline. Whether you like swinging for the fences or pitching in the strike zone, you know baseball is all about batting, pitching, and fielding. The virtual world of baseball is no different. With easy pick-up-and-play mechanics, WBSC eBASEBALL: POWER PROS is fun for both novices and skilled gamers

name: WB Solitaire
summary: WB Solitaire is a collection of seven solitaire card games: Klondike, Spider, FreeCell, TriPeaks, Pyramid, Golf and Yukon. Deals are drawn from pools that a solver has confirmed can be won, and each deal has a number that can be replayed or shared. The game includes hints, a full-solution option, a Daily Deal for each game and weekly goals.
